title: Import the Data Parade knowledge-base pod references into the hosted newsroom
description: Source: the local pod knowledge-base (corpus dataparade-wiki, checkout under the DataParade-io folder), 180 pod reference rows. Import into the canonical corpus of the hosted newsroom through the catalog registration path (papyrus references create-from-catalog). The pod is read only. Its operator CLI config podPath is stale (it points at a path outside the DataParade-io checkout).
